name: LAVENTRA
tagline: The Black Velvet Enigma. Bold, aristocratic, and fiercely magnetic.
description: Draped in tactile midnight black velvet and crowned with a knurled gold cap, LAVENTRA by VELOCEES DE SCENT is an olfactory statement of commanding presence. Woven from high-altitude French lavender, smoky Haitian vetiver, crushed black pepper, and warm amber resin.

notes.top: French High-Altitude Lavender, Crushed Black Pepper, Italian Bergamot
notes.heart: Smoked Haitian Vetiver, Nutmeg, Leather Accord
notes.base: Precious Amber, Tonka Bean Coeur, Cedarwood

occasion: Evening Galas, High-Stakes Meetings & Nights Out

name: UNSPOKEN
tagline: Some things are felt, never spoken. Seductive, warm, and intoxicating.
description: Encased in rich royal bordeaux wine velvet, UNSPOKEN by VELOCEES DE SCENT whispers secrets of forbidden romance and nocturnal passion. A hypnotic harmony of crimson damask roses, warm spiced amber, and Madagascar bourbon vanilla.

notes.top: Crushed Saffron, Candied Plum, Sweet Mandarin Sparkle
notes.heart: Crimson Damask Rose Velvet, Warm Cinnamon, Golden Incense
notes.base: Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla, Ambergris, Cashmere Woods

occasion: Date Nights, Romantic Evenings & Special Milestones
